notes.TWN: 這裡的次數是颱風中心（風速達熱帶風暴以上時）進入台灣陸地或離陸地 100 公里以內，1958–2025 年平均每年 2.9 個。中央氣象署的「侵台颱風」是颱風中心登陸台灣，或沒有登陸但陸上有災情的，同期平均每年 3.2 個；有發布颱風警報的（含只有海上警報）平均每年 6.5 個。風速是美國機構的 1 分鐘平均，比氣象署的 10 分鐘平均大，強度分級也不同。

notesEn.TWN: Counts here are storms whose centre came within 100 km of Taiwan's land (or crossed it) at tropical-storm strength or above: 2.9 a year on average in 1958–2025. Taiwan's Central Weather Administration counts a typhoon as hitting Taiwan when its centre makes landfall or it causes damage on land without landfall: 3.2 a year over the same period, while it issued typhoon warnings (including sea-only warnings) for 6.5 a year. Winds here are US 1-minute averages, higher than the CWA's 10-minute winds, and the intensity scale differs.
